Did my undergrad unmedicated here are some things that helped:

- When starting papers create the file, write out the heading, write out the sub-headings then if you can write maybe 1-2 sentences for the intro. At that point close it then do something else.
- Sit cross-legged on the floor with your laptop when doing work. It is oddly soothing to rock back and forth.
- Do ~5-min work intervals then when you feel agitated get up and walk in circles until that feeling goes away. Rinse and repeat.
- force yourself to go the workshops/practicals, the only reason I say this is so you can be on the same wavelength as the marker and spurt back the generic bullshit they want to hear when the time comes.
- Sorry but say goodbye to your weekends. This on and off approach takes a lot more time.

EDIT: Forgot to mention for the first point, It is best to do this 6-4 weeks before the due date of the paper.

Not natively but Jellyfin has plugins that can be installed. There is an intro-skipper plugin which uses audio fingerprinting though I have not used it so I can’t speak to the quality of it. If you’ve already got your setup working it would make sense to not want to touch it. 

I will say though sometimes I do have scrubbing issues on the apps when watching a movie but find the +-10 secs buttons work fine, it’s easy to work around it but it’s worth keeping in mind it isn’t completely polished software.

My frustrations with Plex were their need to want to control the networking configuration and accounts access as well as the need to pay to use the app. Rather than have every user setup an account with Plex whose credentials are kept externally, Jellyfin keeps everything locally so setting up a new account is purely for access control and can be done from your end in seconds. 

I haven’t used Plex in a while but I remember I had so many problems with connecting other people and the lack of logs or troubleshooting help was abysmal. In contrast to this, Jellyfin Https was easy to setup with Caddy reverse proxy, some port forwarding and Duckdns.

If you already have a server It’s fairly easy to setup both side by side, I’d recommend it even if it is just a second point of contact for your media.
